system.description:
You manifest acidic chakra in the form of a powerful beam meant to melt through everything in its path. All creatures in a 30-foot long, 5-foot-wide line originating from you must make a Dexterity saving throw.

On a failed save, affected creatures become Corroded, takes 3d6 Necrotic or Acid damage (Your choice) and at the beginning of an affected creature’s next turn, they take 3d4 damage of the same type.

Constructs and structures made of earth, metal or wood are treated as if they are vulnerable to this jutsu’s damage.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, the initial damage by 1d6 and the lingering damage by 1d4. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, you can change this jutsu’s range to Self (30-Foot Cone). If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank affected creatures who fails their saving throws takes the lingering damage at the beginning of each of their turns until they spend a Full Turn Action to remove the Acid.
